description: NREL RSF Energy Model 2011 is a model or code deposit deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Michael Sheppy, Aaron Beach. Modern buildings are complex energy systems that must be controlled for energy efficiency. The Research Support Facility (RSF) at the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) has hundreds of controllers (computers that communicate with the building's various control systems) to control the building based on tens of thousands of variables and sensor points. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
